claims.claim: A web server can refer to hardware, server software, or both together; it stores or serves website components and responds to browser requests.
A static web server delivers hosted files as stored, while a dynamic web server adds software such as an application server and database to process or generate content.
Web hosting is rented file space on a hosting company's web server, where the web server provides website content to visitors.
A domain name is a web address; when hosting and domain services are separate, configuration is needed to direct the domain to the correct server.
Website files can reach a host through provider-supported approaches such as an upload interface, an FTP program, a connected source repository, or command-line tools.
Prepared pages and assets can be hosted as static content even when a site includes browser-side JavaScript; dynamic delivery refers to server-side processing before a response is sent.
